    removed = set()
    retained = set(all_ids)

        i += 1

            node['utility'] <= utility_threshold and
            len(children.get(nid, set())) == 0):
            removed.add(nid)
            retained.discard(nid)
            parent = node['parent']
            if parent is not None:
                children[parent].discard(nid)
                if parent not in removed:
                    queue.append(parent)

    return {'retained_node_ids': retained_ids, 'visit_order': visit_order}"}

    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    all_ids = list(node_map.keys())
    
    # Build children adjacency

    for n in nodes:
        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children[pid].add(n['id'])
    
    # Initialize queue sorted by depth descending, then id lexicographically
    queue = sorted(all_ids, key=lambda nid: (-node_map[nid]['depth'], nid))
    
    removed = set()
    retained = set(all_ids)  # we'll remove from this set when removed
    visit_order = []
    
    i = 0

        nid = queue[i]
        i += 1
        
        if nid in removed:

        visit_order.append(nid)
        
        node = node_map[nid]
        # Check removal condition

            retained.discard(nid)

            if parent is not None:
                children[parent].discard(nid)
                # Enqueue parent if not removed
                if parent not in removed:
                    queue.append(parent)
    
    # Retained nodes in original order
    retained_ids = [n['id'] for n in nodes if n['id'] in retained]
    
    return {'retained_node_ids': retained_ids, 'visit_order': visit_order}
